property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer always returns successfully (no revert) when all low-level calls it issues to the target address fail (i.e., the reference treats a failing external call as revert while a succeeding external call continues) — equivalently, for the reference: if an external call to transferFrom fails, C.transfer must revert (so successful completion implies every external call returned true); the mutant inverts the check and will allow completion when calls fail but will revert if a call succeeds, violating this rule for some helper that can be made to fail or succeed.
change_summary: Invert the success check: if the external call returns true then revert; otherwise continue — so successful external calls now cause revert and change return behavior.
